title: Send named data
summary: Fiber: Send named data. Add a pages field.
introduction: JSON writes an object as JSON. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Send named data
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/book", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.JSON(fiber.Map{"title": "Moon Trip"}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: JSON serialises the map as a response object.
